events.verdict: Barnes (SAS) firms up over his right foot as he establishes screening position in Jones' (NOP) path and marginal contact occurs to his side as he defends under the screen.
Castle (SAS) brings his arm forward as he moves alongside Murphy III's (NOP) path and marginal body contact occurs during his upward shooting motion.
Murphy III (NOP) and Wembanyama (SAS) come together at the same spot in the post, and the body to body contact that occurs is marginal.
Jones (NOP) slightly extends his arms forward as he establishes screening position in Fox's (SAS) path and marginal contact occurs to his side as he defends over the screen.
Barnes (SAS) moves alongside Fears' (NOP) path and marginal body contact occurs during the driving shot attempt.
Fears (NOP) initiates foot to foot contact with Wembanyama (SAS) at the start of his drive and the contact affects his SQBR.
Vassell (SAS) is already in Jones' (NOP) path when contact occurs, and he absorbs the marginal contact during the pick.
Fox (SAS) contests the jump shot attempt and avoids making contact with Murphy III's (NOP) arm.
Jones (NOP) reaches in and initiates contact with Fox's (SAS) arm during his drive and the contact affects his SQBR.
Champagnie (SAS) moves alongside Fears' (NOP) path and marginal body contact occurs during the driving shot attempt.
